version.changelog: Simplify the login instructions to the code flow (maton login prints a link; finish with maton login --code <CODE>), drop the API Key subsection, and pin the Maton CLI install to 0.4.0.

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed Attio CRM integration that can read and change CRM data through Maton, with explicit approval requirements for connections, writes, automation, and credential handling.

dimensions.detail: Network access, OAuth, and use of the operating system credential store are proportionate for an authenticated CRM integration. Hosted functions, triggers, and destination forwarding are higher-impact but are disclosed as non-default or explicitly approved automation paths.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation uses a pinned Maton CLI via npm or Homebrew and OAuth login. It also documents a raw HTTP/API-key fallback only for environments without the CLI, with warnings not to persist, print, or send the key outside api.maton.ai.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions default to read/list calls, require explicit user approval for new connections and all writes, require exact endpoint requests for undocumented API calls, and warn that external API content is untrusted data rather than instructions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Persistent elements include OAuth credentials, Maton connections, hosted functions, triggers, destinations, and event-watch checkpoints. The artifact documents approval, least-privilege, deletion, DENY_ALL network policy for functions, and restrictions on third-party destinations.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's stated purpose is managing Attio CRM data, and the documented read, create, update, delete, task, note, comment, list, meeting, function, and trigger capabilities fit that purpose. Some capabilities are high-impact because they can modify or delete business records and set up automation, but they are disclosed and framed with confirmation requirements.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you intend to let Maton access your Attio workspace. Confirm the exact Attio account and connection before use, review every write/delete or automation request carefully, avoid the API-key fallback unless necessary, and be especially cautious with triggers or destinations because they can keep running or forwarding data until removed.
